provenance.method: lesson notes written from the NERDC 2025 scheme of work outline; every week keeps its scheme topic and bullets as the teaching spine

topics.title: Nursery rhymes and folk songs
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to sing folk songs.
The pupils should be able to enjoy the songs.
Introduction:
We know many songs from home.
Today we will learn new folk songs.
Content:
A folk song is a traditional song.
We clap our hands when we sing.
Let us sing "Eku the monkey" together.
Class activity:
We will form a circle and sing folk songs.
We will dance as we sing.
Evaluation questions:
What is a folk song?
Can you name one folk song?
How do you feel when singing?
Summary:
We learned to sing folk songs today.

topics.title: Drawing: my family
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to draw family members.
The pupils should be able to colour the drawing.
Introduction:
We know all the people in our family.
Today we will draw our family.
Content:
We use pencils to draw.
We draw father mother and children.
We can draw a house for our family.
Class activity:
Each pupil will draw their family.
We will use crayons to colour the drawing.
Evaluation questions:
Who do you draw first?
What colours do you use?
Show me your family drawing.
Summary:
We drew and coloured our family members.

topics.title: Pattern making
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to make lines and circles patterns.
The pupils should be able to make card patterns.
Introduction:
We see patterns in our clothes.
Today we will make patterns.
Content:
A pattern is a repeated design.
We can make straight lines patterns.
We can make circles patterns too.
Class activity:
We will make patterns on cards.
We will use coloured pencils for patterns.
Evaluation questions:
What is a pattern?
Can you make a line pattern?
Show me a circle pattern.
Summary:
We made beautiful patterns today.

topics.title: Rhythm with instruments
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to play drum and shekere.
The pupils should be able to play simple beats.
Introduction:
We hear music at parties.
Today we will make music with instruments.
Content:
A drum is a round instrument.
A shekere makes sound with beads.
We hit the drum to make sound.
Class activity:
We will take turns playing the drum.
We will shake the shekere to music.
Evaluation questions:
What sound does a drum make?
How do you play a shekere?
Can you clap to the beat?
Summary:
We played instruments to make music.

topics.title: Local dances
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to dance steps of my area.
The pupils should be able to dance in groups.
Introduction:
We see people dance at weddings.
Today we will learn local dance steps.
Content:
Each area has special dance steps.
We move our feet and body.
We clap our hands when we dance.
Class activity:
We will learn dance steps from our area.
We will dance in small groups.
Evaluation questions:
What is a local dance?
Show me a dance step.
How do you feel when dancing?
Summary:
We danced steps from our local area.

topics.title: Craft: paper folding
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to fold a boat and plane.
The pupils should be able to fly the plane.
Introduction:
We fold paper to make toys.
Today we will fold paper crafts.
Content:
We use square paper for folding.
We fold paper to make a boat.
We fold paper to make a plane too.
Class activity:
We will fold a paper boat together.
We will fold a paper plane and fly it.
Evaluation questions:
What can we make with paper?
How do you fold a boat?
Can your plane fly far?
Summary:
We folded paper to make toys.

topics.title: Beads and threading
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to thread bottle tops.
The pupils should be able to make a necklace.
Introduction:
We see beads on people necks.
Today we will make a necklace.
Content:
We use string and bottle tops.
We put the string through bottle tops.
We can make patterns with bottle tops.
Class activity:
We will thread bottle tops on string.
We will wear our necklaces when done.
Evaluation questions:
What do we use for threading?
How do you make a necklace?
Show me your beautiful necklace.
Summary:
We made necklaces with bottle tops.

topics.title: Drama: market scene
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to act buyer and seller.
The pupils should be able to do market play.
Introduction:
 We go to market with our parents.
Today we will act market scene.
Content:
A buyer buys things from market.
A seller sells things in market.
We use play money for our market.
Class activity:
Some pupils will be sellers.
Some pupils will be buyers.
We will buy and sell fruits.
Evaluation questions:
Who is a buyer?
What does a seller do?
Show me how you buy things.
Summary:
We acted as buyers and sellers in market.

topics.title: Colour mixing
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to mix two colours.
The pupils should be able to name the new colour.
Introduction:
We know red blue and yellow colours.
Today we will mix colours to make new ones.
Content:
When we mix red and yellow we get orange.
When we mix blue and yellow we get green.
Mixing colours makes new beautiful colours.
Class activity:
We will mix paint on paper.
We will name the new colours we make.
Evaluation questions:
What colour do red and yellow make?
Can you make green colour?
Show me your mixed colour.
Summary:
We mixed colours to make new ones.

topics.title: Revision and assessment
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to review term work.
The pupils should be able to display my work.
Introduction:
We learned many things this term.
Today we will show what we know.
Content:
We will sing the songs we learned.
We will show our drawings and crafts.
We will dance the steps we practiced.
Class activity:
Each pupil will show one thing they learned.
We will make a display of all our work.
Evaluation questions:
What did you learn this term?
Show me your best work.
Which activity did you like most?
Summary:
We showed all we learned this term.
